program.section_heading: English for Multilingual Students Listening/Speaking Certificate of Competency
outcomes: Upon completion, the student will be able to apply critical thinking skills and global awareness by analyzing information relevant to global events, presenting arguments, and defending theses.
Upon completion, the student will be able to demonstrate interpersonal, teamwork, and communication skills by preparing group projects and debates.
Upon completion, the student will be able to exhibit multicultural awareness by examining the values and ethics of multinational students.

notes: The catalog prints the codes without a space (EMLSB52NC, EMLSB62NC). They match closed-list EMLS B52NC and EMLS B62NC, so neither is marked as a catalog addition.
The award is counted in hours. The catalog states 'Credits listed are in hours (108 hours)' and '(Total 108)', and prints 54 hours beside each course.

The description says students complete 'more than more than 48 hours' of coursework, with the duplicated phrase as printed. This conflicts with the stated total of 108 hours, so a reviewer should check it.
The requirements nest one 'Complete all of the following' inside another. They are recorded as a single 'all' block.
The URL slug references 'summer-2020', although the page sits in the 2026-2027 catalog. A reviewer should verify that the content is current.
